answer_1.quote: For all but one prefix, we prompt our models to generate free-text answers, from which political stance labels need to be extracted.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to political statements for stance classification and bias measurement.

answer_2.quote: We compute the political bias measure described in Section 2 for each model and report our findings.

answer_4.quote: Two authors of the paper independently annotate 264 randomly sampled instances of LLM answers for political stance.
answer_4.guideline: Assign labels: agree, disagree, neutral, or unrelated to the responses.
